messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy/notice] Scheduled deploy 'release/2026-03-21/ff-toggle' -> targets: api-v2. Post-deploy plan: toggle feature flag `enable_new_routing`. Rollout: staged cohorts. Operator: @Priya (Oncall). Reply with "ack" to confirm or post rollback criteria.
Alex G: ack. High-level plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Wait 15m soak between steps. Pin traffic to model-version 2.1.3 for the first cohort. Keep old route pinned for 30m as fallback.
Maria V: +1. Add rollback triggers: error rate > 2.5% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency +200ms over baseline. Also enable deploy-bot auto-drain on trigger.
Jordan: Suggest first step be region-scoped (eu-west 5%) for faster isolation. Recommend 15m for step1 to let caches warm. Will monitor traces and SLOs.
Priya (Oncall): ACK. I'll watch dashboards. If I see a spike I will run: `ffctl disable enable_new_routing --immediate` and post here. Please confirm exact alert thresholds and the dashboard link.
Alex G: Confirmed thresholds above. Dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/slo/ff-rollout?deploy=6923456789 (watch p50/p90, error-rate, 5xx vol). We'll tag telemetry so it's easy to filter.
deploy-bot: To execute rollout (queued):
```
/ff rollout enable_new_routing --cohort eu-west --pct 5 --wait 15m --tags deploy_id=6923456789,ff_rollout=eu-west-5pct
```
Will also create an ops incident if auto-drain fires.
Maria V: Also add: session-affinity pin of old route for 1h to avoid user session breakage. And mute noisy ephemeral alerts for first 5m to reduce pages for transient timeouts.
Jordan: Noted. We'll keep the older variant pinned with `route_pin=old-routing:v2` and expire after 60m. If step1 looks good, schedule global 25% -> 100% with 30m and 60m waits respectively (total expected ~2h).
Priya (Oncall): I'll mute specified alerts and monitor. If error-rate > 2.5% for 5m I will pause and either rollback or pin back to old route. I'll post actions here.
Alex G: Quick rollback CLI if needed: `/ff rollback enable_new_routing --to disabled --reason "auto"` — deploy-bot will confirm and run drain. Keep everyone posted.
deploy-bot: Step1 scheduled to start in 5m. ETA full rollout (if healthy): ~2h 30m. Will post each step status and link to incident if triggered. :rocket:
Maria V: :thumbsup: good to go.
Priya (Oncall): watching now, will call pause if any spike.
Jordan: I'll tail traces, will post quick summary at t+15m after step1.
Alex G: thanks team, will hold on expanding cohorts until Priya greenlights.
